```{r}
build_season_dataset <- function(current_data,
                                 previous_data,
                                 season_label,
                                 alpha) {

  matches <- current_data %>%
    mutate(
      Date = dmy(as.character(Date)),
      Year = season_label,
      match_id = paste0(
        gsub("/", "", season_label),
        "_",
        row_number()
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(Date, match_id)

  previous_season_matches <- bind_rows(
    previous_data %>%
      transmute(
        Team = HomeTeam,
        goals_for = FTHG,
        goals_against = FTAG,
        result = case_when(
          FTR == "H" ~ "W",
          FTR == "A" ~ "L",
          FTR == "D" ~ "D"
        )
      ),

    previous_data %>%
      transmute(
        Team = AwayTeam,
        goals_for = FTAG,
        goals_against = FTHG,
        result = case_when(
          FTR == "A" ~ "W",
          FTR == "H" ~ "L",
          FTR == "D" ~ "D"
        )
      )
  )

  previous_season_stats <- previous_season_matches %>%
    group_by(Team) %>%
    summarise(
      previous_season_goals_scored_per_match =
        mean(goals_for),

      previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match =
        mean(goals_against),

      previous_season_wins = sum(result == "W"),
      previous_season_draws = sum(result == "D"),
      previous_season_losses = sum(result == "L"),

      previous_season_points =
        sum(if_else(
          result == "W", 3,
          if_else(result == "D", 1, 0)
        )),

      previous_season_goal_difference =
        sum(goals_for - goals_against),

      previous_season_goals_scored = sum(goals_for),

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(previous_season_points),
      desc(previous_season_goal_difference),
      desc(previous_season_goals_scored)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      previous_season_ranking = row_number(),
      RankCategory = case_when(
        previous_season_ranking <= 3  ~ "Top3",
        previous_season_ranking <= 7  ~ "4to7",
        previous_season_ranking <= 12 ~ "8to12",
        previous_season_ranking <= 17 ~ "13to17",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  # Promoted teams: mean of the previous season's bottom three
  bottom3 <- previous_season_stats %>%
    slice_max(previous_season_ranking, n = 3)

  promoted_scored   <- mean(bottom3$previous_season_goals_scored_per_match)
  promoted_conceded <- mean(bottom3$previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match)


  home_data <- matches %>%
    transmute(
      match_id, Date, Year,
      Team = HomeTeam,
      Opponent = AwayTeam,
      HomeAway = "Home",
      goals_for = FTHG,
      goals_against = FTAG,

      result = case_when(
        FTR == "H" ~ "W",
        FTR == "D" ~ "D",
        FTR == "A" ~ "L"
      ),

      red_cards = HR,
      yellow_cards = HY,
      fouls = HF,
      corners = HC,
      shots = HS,
      shots_on_target = HST
    )

  away_data <- matches %>%
    transmute(
      match_id, Date, Year,
      Team = AwayTeam,
      Opponent = HomeTeam,
      HomeAway = "Away",
      goals_for = FTAG,
      goals_against = FTHG,

      result = case_when(
        FTR == "A" ~ "W",
        FTR == "D" ~ "D",
        FTR == "H" ~ "L"
      ),

      red_cards = AR,
      yellow_cards = AY,
      fouls = AF,
      corners = AC,
      shots = AS,
      shots_on_target = AST
    )

  team_matches <- bind_rows(home_data, away_data) %>%
    arrange(Date, match_id, HomeAway)


  team_features <- team_matches %>%
    group_by(Team) %>%
    arrange(Date, match_id, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      matches_played = row_number() - 1L,

      previous_match_date = lag(Date),

      days_since_last_match = as.numeric(
        Date - previous_match_date
      ),

      wins = lag(cumsum(result == "W"), default = 0L),
      draws = lag(cumsum(result == "D"), default = 0L),
      losses = lag(cumsum(result == "L"), default = 0L),

      goals_scored_total =
        lag(cumsum(goals_for), default = 0),

      goals_conceded_total =
        lag(cumsum(goals_against), default = 0),

      red_cards_total =
        lag(cumsum(red_cards), default = 0),

      yellow_cards_total =
        lag(cumsum(yellow_cards), default = 0),

      fouls_total =
        lag(cumsum(fouls), default = 0),

      corners_total =
        lag(cumsum(corners), default = 0),

      shots_total =
        lag(cumsum(shots), default = 0),

      shots_on_target_total =
        lag(cumsum(shots_on_target), default = 0)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      win_frequency = wins / pmax(matches_played, 1),
      loss_frequency = losses / pmax(matches_played, 1),
      draw_frequency = draws / pmax(matches_played, 1),

      goals_scored_per_match = if_else(
        matches_played > 0,
        goals_scored_total / matches_played,
        NA_real_
      ),

      goals_conceded_per_match = if_else(
        matches_played > 0,
        goals_conceded_total / matches_played,
        NA_real_
      ),

      red_cards_per_match = if_else(
        matches_played > 0,
        red_cards_total / matches_played,
        NA_real_
      ),

      yellow_cards_per_match = if_else(
        matches_played > 0,
        yellow_cards_total / matches_played,
        NA_real_
      ),

      fouls_per_match = if_else(
        matches_played > 0,
        fouls_total / matches_played,
        NA_real_
      ),

      corners_per_match = if_else(
        matches_played > 0,
        corners_total / matches_played,
        NA_real_
      ),

      shots_per_match = if_else(
        matches_played > 0,
        shots_total / matches_played,
        NA_real_
      ),

      shots_on_target_per_match = if_else(
        matches_played > 0,
        shots_on_target_total / matches_played,
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    left_join(
      previous_season_stats %>%
        select(
          Team,
          previous_season_goals_scored_per_match,
          previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match,
          previous_season_wins,
          previous_season_draws,
          previous_season_losses,
          previous_season_ranking,
          RankCategory
        ),
      by = "Team"
    ) %>%

    mutate(
      previous_season_goals_scored_per_match =
        coalesce(previous_season_goals_scored_per_match, promoted_scored),
      previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match =
        coalesce(previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match, promoted_conceded),
      RankCategory = coalesce(RankCategory, "Promoted")
    )

  # Calculate exponentially weighted attack and defence scores
  team_features <- team_features %>%
    group_by(Team) %>%
    arrange(Date, match_id, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      d <- .x
      n <- nrow(d)

      # Initialise scores using previous-season averages
      attack <- d$previous_season_goals_scored_per_match[1]
      defence <- d$previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match[1]

      d$attack_score <- numeric(n)
      d$defence_score <- numeric(n)

      for (i in seq_len(n)) {

        # Store scores before this match takes place
        d$attack_score[i] <- attack
        d$defence_score[i] <- defence

        # Update scores using this match for the next match
        attack <- alpha * d$goals_for[i] +
          (1 - alpha) * attack

        defence <- alpha * d$goals_against[i] +
          (1 - alpha) * defence
      }

      d
    }) %>%
    ungroup()

  opponent_features <- team_features %>%
    select(
      match_id, Team,
      matches_played,
      days_since_last_match,
      RankCategory,

      win_frequency,
      loss_frequency,
      draw_frequency,
      attack_score,
      defence_score,

      red_cards_per_match,
      yellow_cards_per_match,
      fouls_per_match,
      corners_per_match,
      shots_on_target_per_match,
      shots_per_match
    ) %>%
    rename_with(
      ~ paste0("opp_", .x),
      -c(match_id, Team)
    ) %>%
    rename(Opponent = Team)

  team_features %>%
    left_join(
      opponent_features,
      by = c("match_id", "Opponent")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      TeamRankCategory = RankCategory,
      OpponentRankCategory = opp_RankCategory,

      Round = matches_played,
      OpponentRound = opp_matches_played,

      # Rest difference in days 
      Days = days_since_last_match - opp_days_since_last_match,

      RestAdvantage = case_when(
        is.na(Days) ~ "Equal",
        Days >= 2   ~ "More",
        Days <= -2  ~ "Less",
        TRUE        ~ "Equal"
      ),

      DWF = win_frequency - opp_win_frequency,
      DLF = loss_frequency - opp_loss_frequency,
      DDF = draw_frequency - opp_draw_frequency,

      DRF = red_cards_per_match - opp_red_cards_per_match,
      DYF = yellow_cards_per_match - opp_yellow_cards_per_match,
      DFF = fouls_per_match - opp_fouls_per_match,
      DCS = corners_per_match - opp_corners_per_match,
      DSTF = shots_on_target_per_match - opp_shots_on_target_per_match,
      DSF = shots_per_match - opp_shots_per_match
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        c(DRF, DYF, DFF, DCS, DSTF, DSF),
        ~ replace_na(.x, 0)
      )
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      match_id, Year, Date, Team, Opponent, HomeAway,
      TeamRankCategory, OpponentRankCategory,
      Round, OpponentRound, RestAdvantage,
      DWF, DLF, DDF,
      attack_score, defence_score,
      opp_attack_score, opp_defence_score,
      DRF, DYF, DFF, DCS, DSTF, DSF,
      Goals = goals_for
    ) %>%
    arrange(match_id, desc(HomeAway == "Home"))
}
```

```{r}
# This is probably not the best formula given that we have not yet done feature selection, but here we are just comparing different alpha and beta values so it is good enough.
poisson_formula <- Goals ~
  HomeAway +
  TeamRankCategory +
  OpponentRankCategory +
  Round +
  OpponentRound +
  RestAdvantage +
  DWF + DLF + DDF +
  attack_score +
  defence_score +
  opp_attack_score +
  opp_defence_score +
  DRF + DYF + DFF + DCS + DSTF + DSF


alpha_grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.05)

beta_grid <- seq(0.05, 1, by = 0.01)


# Mean Poisson deviance
poisson_deviance <- function(y, mu) {

  2 * mean(
    ifelse(y == 0, 0, y * log(y / mu)) - (y - mu)
  )

}


# Turn predicted goals into predicted and actual league tables
season_table <- function(df, beta) {

  mp <- df %>%
    select(
      match_id, HomeAway, Team, Goals, predicted_goals
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = HomeAway,
      values_from = c(Team, Goals, predicted_goals)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      gd = predicted_goals_Home -
        predicted_goals_Away,

      pred_res = case_when(
        abs(gd) <= beta ~ "D",
        gd > beta ~ "H",
        TRUE ~ "A"
      ),

      act_res = case_when(
        Goals_Home > Goals_Away ~ "H",
        Goals_Home < Goals_Away ~ "A",
        TRUE ~ "D"
      )
    )

  pts <- function(res, side) {
    case_when(
      res == side ~ 3,
      res == "D" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  }

  tab <- bind_rows(

    mp %>%
      transmute(
        Team = Team_Home,
        pred_pts = pts(pred_res, "H"),
        act_pts = pts(act_res, "H"),
        pred_gd = gd,
        act_gd = Goals_Home - Goals_Away,
        act_gf = Goals_Home
      ),

    mp %>%
      transmute(
        Team = Team_Away,
        pred_pts = pts(pred_res, "A"),
        act_pts = pts(act_res, "A"),
        pred_gd = -gd,
        act_gd = Goals_Away - Goals_Home,
        act_gf = Goals_Away
      )

  ) %>%
    group_by(Team) %>%
    summarise(
      across(everything(), sum),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(pred_pts), desc(pred_gd), Team) %>%
    mutate(pred_rank = row_number()) %>%
    arrange(desc(act_pts), desc(act_gd), desc(act_gf), Team) %>%
    mutate(act_rank = row_number()) %>%
    arrange(Team)

  list(
    tab = tab,
    mp = mp
  )
}
```

```{r}
get_valid_preds <- function(training_data, poisson_formula) {

  seasons <- training_data %>%
    distinct(Year) %>%
    mutate(s = as.integer(substr(Year, 1, 4))) %>%
    arrange(s) %>%
    pull(Year)

  map_dfr(seasons[-1], function(sn) {

    tr <- training_data %>%
      filter(
        Year %in% seasons[
          seq_len(match(sn, seasons) - 1)
        ]
      )

    va <- training_data %>%
      filter(Year == sn)

    m <- glm(
      poisson_formula,
      data = tr,
      family = poisson(link = "log")
    )

    va %>%
      mutate(
        predicted_goals = predict(
          m,
          newdata = va,
          type = "response"
        )
      )
  })
}


choose_beta <- function(training_data,
                        poisson_formula,
                        beta_grid) {

  valid_preds <- get_valid_preds(
    training_data,
    poisson_formula
  )

  # Actual outcome proportions
  actual_props <- training_data %>%
    filter(Year %in% unique(valid_preds$Year)) %>%
    select(Year, match_id, HomeAway, Goals) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = HomeAway,
      values_from = Goals
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      H = mean(Home > Away),
      D = mean(Home == Away),
      A = mean(Home < Away)
    )

  # Predicted goal differences
  gd_data <- valid_preds %>%
    select(
      Year, match_id, HomeAway, predicted_goals
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = HomeAway,
      values_from = predicted_goals
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      gd = Home - Away
    )

  # Test each beta
  prop_sweep <- map_dfr(beta_grid, function(b) {

    tibble(
      Beta = b,
      pred_H = mean(gd_data$gd > b),
      pred_D = mean(abs(gd_data$gd) <= b),
      pred_A = mean(gd_data$gd < -b)
    )

  }) %>%
    mutate(
      dist =
        (pred_H - actual_props$H)^2 +
        (pred_D - actual_props$D)^2 +
        (pred_A - actual_props$A)^2
    )

  prop_sweep %>%
    slice_min(
      dist,
      n = 1,
      with_ties = FALSE
    ) %>%
    pull(Beta)
}
```

```{r}
run_alpha <- function(alpha) {

  # Build all season datasets using this alpha
  training_data <- map_dfr(
    seq_along(season_data_training),
    function(i) {

      build_season_dataset(
        current_data = season_data_training[[i]],
        previous_data = training_prev[[i]],
        season_label = names(season_data_training)[i],
        alpha = alpha
      )

    }
  )

  # Get seasons in chronological order
  seasons <- training_data %>%
    distinct(Year) %>%
    mutate(s = as.integer(substr(Year, 1, 4))) %>%
    arrange(s) %>%
    pull(Year)

  # Use an expanding-window validation technique
  map_dfr(6:length(seasons), function(i) {

    # All seasons before the validation season
    train_fold <- training_data %>%
      filter(
        Year %in% seasons[1:(i - 1)]
      )

    # Next validation season
    valid_fold <- training_data %>%
      filter(Year == seasons[i])

    # Choose beta using training seasons only
    beta_chosen <- choose_beta(
      training_data = train_fold,
      poisson_formula = poisson_formula,
      beta_grid = beta_grid
    )

    # Fit Poisson model on all previous seasons
    final_model <- glm(
      poisson_formula,
      data = train_fold,
      family = poisson(link = "log")
    )

    # Predict validation-season goals
    valid_fold <- valid_fold %>%
      mutate(
        predicted_goals = predict(
          final_model,
          newdata = valid_fold,
          type = "response"
        )
      )

    # Evaluate predicted league table
    st <- season_table(
      valid_fold,
      beta_chosen
    )

    # Store results
    tibble(
      alpha = alpha,
      Season = seasons[i],
      beta = beta_chosen,

      rank_mse = mean(
        (st$tab$pred_rank - st$tab$act_rank)^2
      ),

      spearman = cor(
        st$tab$pred_rank,
        st$tab$act_rank,
        method = "spearman"
      ),

      deviance = poisson_deviance(
        valid_fold$Goals,
        valid_fold$predicted_goals
      ),

      pred_draw = mean(
        st$mp$pred_res == "D"
      )
    )

  })
}


# Run sensitivity analysis across all alpha values
alpha_results <- map_dfr(
  alpha_grid,
  run_alpha
)

alpha_results %>%
  arrange(alpha, Season)

alpha_summary <- alpha_results %>%
  group_by(alpha) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Rank_MSE = mean(rank_mse, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Spearman = mean(spearman, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Deviance = mean(deviance, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Pred_Draw = mean(pred_draw, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Beta = mean(beta, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


alpha_summary %>%
  arrange(Mean_Rank_MSE)

# Poisson deviance
ggplot(alpha_summary, aes(alpha, Mean_Deviance)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Alpha",
    y = "Mean Poisson deviance",
    title = "Effect of alpha on Poisson deviance"
  )


# Ranking MSE
ggplot(alpha_summary, aes(alpha, Mean_Rank_MSE)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Alpha",
    y = "Mean squared rank error",
    title = "Effect of alpha on ranking performance"
  )


# Spearman correlation
ggplot(alpha_summary, aes(alpha, Mean_Spearman)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Alpha",
    y = "Mean Spearman rank correlation",
    title = "Effect of alpha on ranking correlation"
  )


# Selected beta
ggplot(alpha_summary, aes(alpha, Mean_Beta)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Alpha",
    y = "Mean selected beta",
    title = "Effect of alpha on the selected beta"
  )
```
